text: And every animal on Earth is gone.
And not a single creature makes a sound.
Without bees and other pollinators, many plants can no longer reproduce.
Supermarkets begin running out of food.
Forests lose the creatures that spread seeds.
And without worms and insects, the soil stops breathing, and even more crops die.
The world is falling out of balance.
Millions of people face food shortages.
And ecosystems that took millions of years to develop begin breaking apart.
Humanity is running out of time.
But the world is becoming unrecognizable.
We thought animals needed us to survive.
